Super style guide

About Colour Type Shape Components

Super, measured

Every colour, radius and type style on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. The public site at super.so paints one light theme. html.theme-dark is declared in CSS and was not switched, so this guide has no dark toggle. Beausite is not loaded. Samples use Helvetica, then the system sans. The real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Colour

The yellow call to action is a computed fill, light.accent (#ffbe3c). It is not an alias of core.color.yellow (#ffaa00). Notion ink roles live under core.color.

Palette

Type

Visible titles are h1.notion-heading. The document h1.notion-header__title is 0 by 0 and is not the hero.

Shape

Radius steps that were measured on Super controls, plus the declared floating-toc panel radius. Spacing tokens are control paddings, not a product scale.

Components

Redrawn from the tokens. Crops of the live controls are in components/crops/.
